title: Build a cushion
intro: Life brings costs you do not plan for. This Lesson shows how a small fund protects you. It also shows how savings grow over time.

check.prompt: An emergency fund is money for holidays.
check.explanation: Myth. An emergency fund is only for costs you did not plan.

check.prompt: Lan saves $1,000 at 5% a year and adds nothing. How much does she have after two years?
check.explanation: She has about $1,102. The second year pays interest on the first year's interest.
